title: Consolidate auth/backoff surface and streamline streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go SDKs
author: Priya Menon
release_notes:
- Introduce unified RetryProfile and lightweight credential hinting across Python/TS/Go SDKs.
- Stream API ergonomics: cancelable pull-stream helpers and stable resume hints.
- Version bumps: py v1.12.0, ts v2.4.0, go v1.5.0.
description:
Context and motivation:
This PR aligns three SDK codepaths (Python, TypeScript, Go) for credential rotation, backoff presets, and streaming ergonomics. Teams reported subtle mismatches in reauth handshake timing and retry semantics across languages leading to spurious reconnects and metric noise (see ENG-8921). The goal here is to provide a small, well-documented surface (RetryProfile + CredentialHint) that is behaviorally consistent across SDKs while preserving idiomatic APIs for each language.

Summary of changes (one-liner):
Consolidate auth/backoff config, add compact RetryProfile API, introduce cancelable pullstream helpers and stream resume hints, and bump SDK versions to ship the unified surface.

Checklist:
- [x] Design: RetryProfile spec + cross-SDK examples added to Linear (ENG-8921).
- [x] Python: add retry_profile class, adjust token refresh window, add pullstream cancel helper.
- [x] TypeScript: add RetryProfile types, clarify stream iterator docstrings, small ergonomic sugar for cursor resumption.
- [x] Go: implement compact retry presets, add lightweight session hints, keep zero-allocation hot path for bulk reads.
- [x] E2E tests: added cross-lang integration smoke tests and flakiness guard rails.
- [x] Telemetry: emit retry_profile.name and credential_hint in all outgoing request spans.
- [x] CI green and reviewers approved.

Commits (summary):
- 73a2b9d: spec(retry): add RetryProfile proto + description + examples across SDKs
- b4f1a3e: python(sdk): introduce RetryProfile, session lease hint, tests; bump py SDK to v1.12.0
- c81e4ff: ts(sdk): add RetryProfile types, stream helpers, docs; bump ts SDK to v2.4.0
- d9f07b6: go(sdk): compact retry presets, session hint pass-through, benchmarks; bump go SDK to v1.5.0
- e12f443: infra: add cross-sdk smoke e2e and CI matrix update

Files changed (high level):
- sdk/python/redwood/retry.py (+120/-18): new RetryProfile class, presets, backcompat adapter for existing retry kwargs.
- sdk/python/redwood/streaming.py (+80/-12): cancelable PullStream wrapper, resume_hint plumbing.
- sdk/typescript/src/retry.ts (+95/-22): exported RetryProfile type and presets.
- sdk/typescript/src/stream/index.ts (+60/-8): pullstream helpers and small docs.
- sdk/go/retry/retry.go (+140/-35): compact presets and adapter API.
- sdk/go/stream/stream.go (+70/-10): session hint propagation and cancel token.
- docs/sdk/retry.md (+40/-0): cross-language examples and guidance for production settings.
- tests/e2e/cross_sdk/retry_smoke.py (+200/-0): smoke harness that exercises token rotation and backoff handoffs.
- ci/matrix.yaml (+10/-2): add matrix axis for combined SDK smoke test.

Small illustrative snippet (python adapter):
- New adapter keeps older kwargs working while encouraging new pattern:
  def __init__(self, *, retry_profile: Optional[RetryProfile] = None, max_retries: Optional[int] = None):
      # if the old args were used, build a legacy profile to preserve behavior
      self._profile = retry_profile or _legacy_to_profile(max_retries)

Review conversation (high-level):
- Ethan Park (reviewer): "Left a few nits on naming and one question about default TTL for the lease window — we should avoid reauth storms in bursty scenarios."
  - Author response (Priya): "Agreed — bumped default lease window from 15s to 30s and added a configurable env var. Updated tests to simulate bursts."
- Marta Lopez (reviewer): "Can we avoid allocations on hot path in Go (we measured on prod-like harness)?"
  - Author response: "Addressed — compact preset uses stack-allocated buffers where possible and added a microbenchmark alongside the change. See go/retry/bench_test.go"
- Zachary Cole (reviewer): "Docs look good, please add a short migration note for teams using old retry kwargs."
  - Author response: "Added a migration subsection in docs/sdk/retry.md and a deprecation log line for one release cycle."

CI history:
- Initial run: yarn test / pytest / go test matrix had one flaky TS streaming test that timed out in the Windows runner.
- Reran the matrix with extended timeout for streaming smoke tests; all green. CI final status: pass.

Compatibility and migration notes:
- No breaking changes: existing retry kwargs are translated to the new RetryProfile via adapter layer. Teams are encouraged to adopt RetryProfile for clarity and telemetry.
- SDK bumps: Python v1.12.0, TypeScript v2.4.0, Go v1.5.0 — upgrade recommended for consistency across services.

Why this approach:
- Centralizing the concept (RetryProfile + credential/lease hint) reduces cross-language drift and makes server-side debugging/telemetry straightforward (span tags are consistent).
- Ergonomic per-language helpers keep the surface small and familiar for idiomatic consumers while allowing a single documented behavior matrix.

Follow-ups (tracked in Linear):
- ENG-8980: evaluate additional backoff presets for high-latency regions (work scheduled for next sprint).
- ENG-9002: extend SDK smoke matrix to include a small golden dataset to detect regressions in retry behavior.

Merge details:
- Approved by reviewers after two rounds of feedback; merged via squash on 2026-02-23.
- Changelog entry prepared and release PRs for the three SDK packages created after merge.

If you want to test locally:
1) python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e sdk/python[dev]
2) node -v >=16 && cd sdk/typescript && npm ci && npm run build
3) go 1.20+ and run go test ./sdk/go/...
